tools.name: list_flowpoint_free_tools
tools.description: List every free browser-based tool on flowpoint.ai, grouped by category, with the URL of each. Use this to find which tool page can perform a calculation or conversion.

category.description: Restrict the list to a single category. Omit to list all of them.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Open a page on flowpoint.ai in the current tab. Use search_flowpoint_content or list_flowpoint_free_tools first to find the path.

path.description: Site-relative path starting with a slash, for example "/tools/nps-calculator".

tools.name: search_flowpoint_content
tools.description: Search the Flowpoint website for pages, free tools, blog articles, and customer case studies matching a topic. Returns titles, URLs, and descriptions.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words — for example "conversion rate", "contrast checker", or "design to code".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.
